summary: Liberty Media Corp filed an 8-K reporting the stockholder-approved reincorporation from Delaware to Nevada, effective May 12, 2026. The conversion did not change headquarters, business, management, assets, liabilities, or net worth. Each share of common stock automatically converted on a one-for-one basis into shares of the Nevada entity. No premium, consideration, tender offer, acquisition, or buyback is involved. The filing is a routine corporate domicile change with no special-situation investment thesis; it is a procedural item. No risk-arb angle exists.
